mapper.select: SELECT id, template_code, recipient_ciphertext, payload_ciphertext, encryption_key_version, business_key, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, locked_by, locked_at FROM mail_outbox WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY', 'SENDING') AND next_retry_at <= #{now} AND (status <> 'SENDING' OR locked_at < #{lockExpiredBefore}) ORDER BY next_retry_at, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE mail_outbox SET status = 'SENDING', locked_by = #{lockedBy}, locked_at = #{lockedAt}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id IN #{id}

UPDATE mail_outbox SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = #{sentAt}, last_error_code = NULL, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING' AND locked_by = #{lockedBy}

UPDATE mail_outbox SET status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING' AND locked_by = #{lockedBy}
